# Mastermind Council

> Mastermind Council is a free web app at council.dravec.org. You bring an idea — a business, a
> project, a decision you keep turning over — pick up to four historical thinkers, and they debate
> it among themselves for a few rounds before returning a verdict and one next action. You can
> answer back and the debate continues. English UI, works on a phone, no account needed for the
> first session, no ads, no tracking cookies. Every persona is a fictional interpretation written
> by an AI model from public-domain sources, not the real person.

## What it is
- The main flow is a facilitated conversation: pick a roster (Business — simulations inspired by
  Peter Drucker, Steve Jobs, Andy Grove, plus Socrates — or the seven Classics), answer a short
  optional intake, then talk with the group and steer it. Decisions you accept go into a journal,
  with an optional dated commitment and an opt-in email reminder.
- The quick verdict (https://council.dravec.org/quick) is the original one-shot debate.
- A council of seven thinkers: Socrates, Marcus Aurelius, Seneca (on by default), plus Buddha,
  Confucius, Benjamin Franklin and Maria Montessori. Up to four sit at once.
- Each session ends in a verdict card: a summary, one next action, and each thinker's vote
  (for / against / mixed).
- One shared daily question, the same for everyone, date-keyed from a committed list of 30. The
  result card you can share carries the date, the question and the vote split — never your text.
- Signed-in sessions are kept under "My ideas"; anonymous ones stay in the browser.

## How to use it
- Open https://council.dravec.org/, type what you are working on, tick the thinkers, convene.
- Or answer today's shared question straight from the home screen.

## Honest caveats
- The personas are fictional interpretations generated by an AI model from public-domain texts.
  They are not the words, opinions or endorsement of the real people or their estates, and the
  app gives no medical, legal or financial advice.
- Not affiliated with any Montessori organisation or estate.
- The council refuses hate, self-harm and medical requests, and offers no religious absolution.
